workItem: FIN-TIER3-CACHE-FANOUT — bounded post-DQ ring-buffer, delta and Redis/WebSocket fan-out core
priorityReason: Fresh Human Owner direction requests Tier-3 cache and fan-out directly behind the existing provider/evidence/DQ path without creating a second market-data authority.
scopeBoundary: Tier 3 consumes only canonical post-DQ MarketDataGateway snapshots and creates no provider, evidence, DQ, scoring or execution authority.
No provider promotion, trading capability, score formula, execution eligibility or frontend-local market truth is introduced.
Redis is a bounded cache/distribution projection; loss of Redis or WebSocket fan-out cannot turn invalid or unavailable data into valid market evidence.
Public WebSocket transport activation remains gated by data redistribution/entitlement evidence and an explicit server transport dependency/integration slice.
No Render, Upstash, secret, IAM, billing or production-provider mutation is performed by this repository slice.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct main mutation or self-merge.
